1. ESTABLISH – RESIDENTIAL PERMIT PARKING AREA S (Eligibility only, no signs)
24th Street, both sides, between Castro Street and Noe Street (Supervisor District 8) (Requires
approval by the SFMTA Board) Lulu Brien, [staff email removed — see the order]

both sides, between Castro Street and Noe Street (excluding parcels that already have eligibility: 4000-

that they can purchase parking permits for their vehicle to park within RPP Area S.

implementation.
